subject: Commercial pathway check + billing ops next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lara Singh <lara@evergreenops.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing info

Hi Lara — thanks again for the product walkthrough this morning. Appreciate the clarity on your use case (high-volume embeddings for search + a ramping multitenant LLM feature). Quick recap and the specific items we need from your billing/ops team to get EvergreenOps ready for a commercial pilot: 

Summary of call:
- Pilot scope: 3 models (embedding + standard generation) across 3 environments (dev/staging/prod).
- Expected monthly token volume: ~1.2B tokens after month 2.
- Compliance note: data residency requirement for EU customers (later stage) but pilot will run in us-east.

Billing & procurement items we discussed (please confirm):
1) Commercial path: are you going to purchase via corporate card or raise a PO? If PO, any internal reference format?
2) Net terms: does EvergreenOps require net-30 / net-45 / net-60?
3) Invoice fields: billing name, tax/VAT ID, billing address (full), and a contact for AP.
4) Marketplace interest: would you prefer transacting via AWS Marketplace (we support marketplace billing) or direct invoice?

My ask: can you share a copy of your PO template (even redacted) and confirm preferred net terms and billing address? I attached our invoice spec PDF for AP so your team can validate fields.

Next steps:
- If PO path: Priya (cc) will validate the PO format vs our invoicing requirements and flag any blockers.
- If card: I can send a revised pilot invoice and payment link.
- If marketplace: Marissa (cc) can kick off marketplace onboarding and share timelines.

Thanks — if easier, we can hop on a 15-min call with your AP team later this week.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood-Invoice-Specs.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Lara Singh <lara@evergreenops.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@evergreenops.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: RE: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing info

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. See answers below from our finance lead (copied).

Answers: 
1) Commercial path: EvergreenOps prefers to use PO for anything >$10k. For pilots under $10k we can use a corporate card. This pilot will likely exceed that threshold in month 2, so PO is our preference. I attached our PO template for your review.
2) Net terms: Our standard is net-45 but procurement has flexibility for strategic vendors to move to net-30. Would Redwood consider net-30 for the pilot and then revisit for production?
3) Invoice fields: billing name: Evergreen Operations, Inc.; billing address: 201 Commerce Blvd, Boston, MA 02110; VAT/Tax ID: US-EIN 12-3456789 (we don't have EU VAT for this entity); AP contact: finance@evergreenops.com.
4) Marketplace: We prefer direct invoicing for now to keep pilot paperwork simple; we may evaluate marketplace in Q1 for production.

Question for Redwood: does Redwood include line-item usage detail (tokens per model) on monthly invoices or only aggregated totals? Also, do you support adding a PO number on invoices? Procurement requires PO number on the invoice to process payment.

Thanks,
Lara Singh
Head of Product, EvergreenOps
lara@evergreenops.com

Attachment: EvergreenOps_PO_Template.docx

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Lara Singh <lara@evergreenops.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: RE: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing info

Thanks Lara — great detail, appreciate the PO template. Quick notes from billing ops: 

1) PO number: yes, we can add a PO number field to the invoice PDF and to the invoice metadata we send via email/portal. Please ensure the PO number is included on the PO document you submit so AP can route it.
2) Line-item detail: our standard monthly invoice includes per-model usage rows (tokens and unit price) and a monthly summary. We can provide an expanded CSV export with hourly breakdown on request (usually provided for >$50k monthly spend or on-demand for pilots).
3) Net terms: Redwood standard for new commercial pilots is net-30. For this pilot, we can accept net-30 as a one-off; finance will require a short written approval (email thread is fine).
4) Billing address + tax fields: we will put the full billing address and the EIN on the invoice. For future EU entities we support VAT line items and reverse-charge annotations.

Action items I will take:
- Validate the PO template against our invoice fields (we flagged two line-item labels that map differently — see inline comments on the attached spec).
- Create a pilot invoice draft with PO number placeholder and send to finance@evergreenops.com for pre-approval.

Ben / Marissa: can you confirm timing on the pilot start date so I can propose invoice dates and the initial pro-rated period?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Billing Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood-Invoice-Specs.pdf (annotated), internal-billing-checklist.txt

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lara Singh <lara@evergreenops.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: RE: RE: Quick follow-up — procurement & billing info

Perfect — thanks Priya and Lara. Quick internal note/next steps (Ben -> Sales playbook actions):

- Confirm pilot start: propose kickoff 2026-11-15 (2-week setup). Marissa to confirm infra readiness with infra team and confirm any seat limits for early access.
- Priya: please generate a pilot invoice draft with PO placeholder and send to finance@evergreenops.com by EOD Friday (2026-11-06). Use net-30 and include per-model line items; attach the CSV export as optional.
- Lara: if procurement can send a signed PO before 11/12 we can lock the pilot start date. Otherwise we will accept corporate card payment for first month and then transition to PO.

I'll schedule a 15-min AP alignment call for Friday to walk through the invoice fields and PO flow — calendar invite coming.

Ben Carter
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
